companies.name: ライフタイム・ブランズ

relations.text: Lifetime Brandsの販売先(オフプライス小売)の一社がRoss Stores
relations.text_en: Ross Stores is one of the off-price retailers that sell Lifetime Brands products

source.label: Lifetime Brands 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: off-price retailers (such as TJX Companies and Ross Stores)

relations.text: Ross Storesが上位5テナントの一社(年間基本賃料の1.8%)
relations.text_en: Ross Stores is one of its five largest tenants, 1.8% of annualized base rent

source.label: Kimco Realty 10-Q(2025年第1四半期)
source.quote: At March 31, 2025, the Company's five largest tenants were The TJX Companies, Ross Stores, The Home Depot, Burlington Stores, Inc. and Amazon/Whole Foods

relations.text: 主なテナントの一社としてRoss Storesを挙げる
relations.text_en: Names Ross Stores among its retailer tenants

source.label: Brixmor の発表(8-K添付)
source.quote: Brixmor is a proud real estate partner to over 5,000 retailers including The TJX Companies, The Kroger Co., Publix Super Markets and Ross Stores.

relations.text: Kohl'sの役員契約で、競合先の一社としてRoss Storesを定義
relations.text_en: A Kohl's executive agreement defines Ross Stores as a competitor

source.label: Kohl's 役員契約(8-K/A添付)
source.quote: The term "Competitor" means Amazon.com, Inc., Belk, Inc., Burlington Stores, Inc., Dillard's, Inc., J.C. Penney Company, Inc., Macy's, Inc., Nordstrom Co., Old Navy, Inc., Ross Stores, Inc.

relations.text: Citi Trendsの役員契約で、競合先の一社としてRoss Storesを定義
relations.text_en: A Citi Trends executive agreement defines Ross Stores as a competitor

source.label: Citi Trends 役員契約(10-Q添付)
source.quote: Cato, TJX (including without limitation TJMAXX and Marshalls), Burlington Stores, Gabe's/Rugged Wearhouse, and Ross Stores.
